_doc: Materials a planet can be mined for. `baseline` is the set every world carries in some amount (abundance 0..1, so a lava world still has 'water ice' — just almost none of it). `rare` is the interesting half: each planet gets 1–2 of these, drawn from the entries whose `worlds` list contains its archetype. Every name here is invented for this playground — see rule 9 in CLAUDE.md. Colours are for map keys, item icons and UI chips; `tags` are what a crafting or quest system should match on; `value` is a rough credits-per-unit hint so a game has somewhere to start.

baseline.name: Base Metals
baseline.blurb: iron, nickel and copper in the crust — the floor of any supply chain

baseline.name: Stone
baseline.blurb: rock to cut, crush and build with

baseline.name: Water Ice
baseline.blurb: water, frozen or liquid — drinking, cooling and split for fuel

baseline.name: Volatile Gas
baseline.blurb: light gases held in the atmosphere or in pockets underground

rare.name: Aetherite
rare.blurb: a violet crystal that holds a charge far longer than it should; the usual core of a jump drive

rare.name: Cryonite
rare.blurb: ice that stays frozen well above freezing — every reactor coolant loop wants it

rare.name: Voltaic Ore
rare.blurb: a streaked metal laid down by lightning; cuts battery mass roughly in half

rare.name: Pyrocrystal
rare.blurb: burns from the inside for months once lit — furnace fuel and, less wisely, a weapon

rare.name: Xenoplasm
rare.blurb: a living gel that knits torn tissue; it also eats through seals if the cold chain breaks

rare.name: Umbral Shale
rare.blurb: rock that swallows light and most of the spectrum around it; the best hull shielding known

rare.name: Glimmer Salt
rare.blurb: salt flats that glow for a night after a hot day; refined into signal flares and lamps

rare.name: Ferrovine
rare.blurb: a creeper that pulls metal out of the soil and lays it down in its stems; a farm, not a mine

rare.name: Helion Gas
rare.blurb: the clean fusion feedstock, skimmed from the top of a giant's atmosphere

rare.name: Nullstone
rare.blurb: a dull grey stone that quietly drains any field laid across it; rare enough to start arguments

rare.name: Emberlace
rare.blurb: copper threads grown in cooling lava; the finest heat exchangers are woven from it

rare.name: Brinepearl
rare.blurb: grown by something in the deep water; ground up it keeps a crew's bones from thinning on a long haul
